description: Bilingual (Romanian-English) and synonym dictionary. Since the English-only core decision of 2026-10-01 the product linking reads only its English synonym sets (`englishDictionary()` in sop/dictionary.mjs); the Romanian columns serve language identification, the gloss translator backend and the archived evaluations (DS014 'Input languages and content words'). Sources are listed in priority order: a lower priority number wins when two sources give different entries for the same surface. Loaded by sop/dictionary.mjs; maintained with tools/dictionary.mjs. The `frames` list holds the host frame and synonym list of sop/frames.mjs (owner answer to Q-SYM-2): relation frames with their declared roles and surfaces, used only by host normalization after the formalizer, never by strict scoring.
